articles.title: Michael Gilroy Jitmau: From Setbacks to a Digital Future
articles.description: Michael Gilroy Jitmau is a digital creator from Papua whose journey through university, setbacks, and a new beginning led him to a bachelor's degree in Information Systems and a growing passion for AI and digital technology.
articles.dek: His journey was anything but straight: five years studying Informatics, two difficult years away from university, a new beginning at Ottow Geissler Papua, and finally a bachelor's degree in Information Systems.
articles.intro: Not every digital journey begins with a perfect plan. For Michael Gilroy Jitmau, the road to technology has been full of unexpected turns, difficult decisions, new beginnings, and lessons that eventually shaped the person he is today.

sections.heading: A University Journey That Took an Unexpected Turn
paragraphs: Michael started his university journey in 2015 by studying Informatics at Universitas Muhammadiyah Sorong (UNAMIN Sorong). At the time, technology was already becoming an important part of the world he wanted to understand.
He continued studying Informatics from 2015 to 2020. However, his university journey did not go exactly as planned, and he eventually left the program without completing his degree.

Looking back, those years became an important part of his story. University was not only about classrooms and assignments; it was also where Michael built friendships, gained experiences, and began discovering the direction he wanted to take in life.

sections.heading: The “Cap Tikus” Chapter 😅
paragraphs: Every life story has a chapter that people may not be proud of, but those chapters can also become important lessons.

During his university years, Michael went through a difficult period in which alcohol, including Cap Tikus, became part of the choices that affected his direction in life. He openly recognizes that period as one of the factors behind his decision to leave his first university program.

Looking back, Michael sees it as a lesson rather than something to celebrate. Sometimes growing up means being honest about the choices that did not work, learning from them, and finding the courage to start again.

sections.heading: Two Years of Uncertainty
paragraphs: From 2020 to 2022, Michael went through a period of uncertainty. He was no longer continuing his previous university program, and he was also not working.
Those two years were not easy. Without a clear academic or professional direction, Michael had to face a period of waiting, reflection, and uncertainty about what would come next.
But sometimes a pause is not the end of the journey. It can become the moment when a person realizes that something needs to change and finds the courage to begin again.

sections.heading: A New University. A New Major. A New Start. 🎓
paragraphs: In 2022, Michael decided to start again. He enrolled at Universitas Ottow Geissler Papua and chose Information Systems as his new field of study.
Starting over was not simply about entering a new university. It meant carrying the lessons of the past while trying to build a different future.

This time, Michael had a clearer direction. His interest in technology continued, but his academic path shifted from Informatics toward Information Systems, giving him a new perspective on how technology and people can work together.
From 2022 to 2025, he continued his studies and worked toward completing the degree he had once been unable to finish.

sections.heading: The Road to Graduation 🎓
paragraphs: Starting over at a new university required commitment. From 2022 to 2025, Michael continued his studies in Information Systems at Universitas Ottow Geissler Papua and worked toward completing his bachelor's degree.
This time, he stayed with the journey. The years of studying, completing academic responsibilities, and moving forward step by step eventually brought him to the moment he had been working toward.
On October 3, 2025, Michael took part in the Bachelor's and Master's graduation ceremony at Universitas Ottow Geissler Papua for the 2024/2025 academic year in Jayapura.

After years of an unexpected academic journey, he finally graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems. For Michael, the graduation was more than a ceremony—it represented a second chance that he chose not to waste.

sections.heading: What University Taught Me Beyond the Classroom
paragraphs: University gave Michael more than academic knowledge. It gave him experiences, friendships, challenges, mistakes, and opportunities to understand himself better.

His first university journey taught him that having a plan does not always mean everything will go according to that plan. Sometimes life takes an unexpected turn, and the challenge is learning how to respond.

Starting university again in 2022 gave Michael another opportunity to approach his education differently. The experience taught him the value of persistence, responsibility, and not giving up simply because the first attempt did not work out.
His graduation in 2025 became a reminder that a delayed journey is not necessarily a failed journey. Sometimes the road simply takes longer than expected.

sections.heading: From Information Systems to the World of AI 🤖
paragraphs: After graduating with a bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Michael's interest in technology did not stop with university. Instead, graduation became another starting point for exploring what he could build with the technology available today.
One of the areas that has captured his attention is artificial intelligence. Michael has been experimenting with AI tools for writing, image generation, video creation, ideas, and digital content.
For him, AI is not simply about asking a machine to create something. It is also a way to learn new technology, experiment with ideas, solve problems, and discover new possibilities.

His background in Informatics and Information Systems gives him a foundation for understanding technology, while his current experiments with AI are helping him explore a rapidly changing digital world.

sections.heading: What Michael Is Building Today 🚀
paragraphs: Today, Michael is working on Jaziel, a digital publishing project designed to bring English-language stories and content to a global audience.
Jaziel combines several areas that Michael has become interested in, including artificial intelligence, website development, digital publishing, SEO, visual content, and automation.

One of the systems he is developing is an AI-assisted writing workflow. Instead of starting every article completely from scratch, Michael can provide source material and use AI to help transform it into a structured article that can then be reviewed and edited before publication.
He is also building the website and its administration system around this workflow. The goal is to make the process of creating, organizing, editing, and publishing digital stories more efficient.
Michael is still learning as he builds. Some ideas work immediately, while others require testing, fixing, and trying again. That process has become an important part of how he approaches technology.

Jaziel is therefore not just a website for Michael. It is also a practical project where he can apply what he has learned, experiment with AI, and continue developing his skills in digital technology.

sections.heading: From Papua to the World 🌏
paragraphs: Michael's journey began in Papua, Indonesia, but his ambitions are not limited by geography. Through digital technology, he wants to create content that can reach people beyond his local environment.

The internet gives individual creators an opportunity to build something from almost anywhere. Michael is exploring that opportunity by developing Jaziel for an English-speaking and international audience.

His journey also shows that a person's starting point does not have to determine where they eventually go. A difficult university experience, a period without work or studies, and the need to start again became chapters in a much longer story.
Today, Michael is combining his education, personal experiences, curiosity about technology, and interest in AI to build something of his own.
The destination is still ahead, but the direction is becoming clearer: keep learning, keep building, and keep finding ways to turn ideas into something real.

bibleVerse.text: Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established.

articles.closing:
Michael Gilroy Jitmau's story is not a story of a perfect journey. It is a story of taking unexpected turns, making mistakes, starting again, and eventually finding a way forward.
From studying Informatics at UNAMIN Sorong, through a difficult period between 2020 and 2022, to starting again at Universitas Ottow Geissler Papua and graduating with a bachelor's degree in Information Systems in 2025, every chapter became part of the journey.
Now, his next chapter is being written through AI, digital content, technology, and Jaziel.
The story that started in Papua is now reaching toward a much bigger world.
The journey continues.
